title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
code_status: Author project page says Code soon at verification date
notes: Original forecaster jointly predicts scene and hand displacement trajectories through deterministic MLP heads with squared-error supervision. It is not a demonstrated multimodal sampler. The similarly named xiaooai/PointWAM repository is not treated as official author code.
